# README cover

Created with the built-in imagegen tool and reviewed before publication. A conceptual native desktop UI using synthetic values and project names; no real account or desktop content. The reference moodboard was used only for visual direction and is not distributed.

The cover uses shallow graphite glass, thin highlights and compact native controls. Quota rings, colored folder outlines and Token indicators share one sidebar surface. The original generated PNG and provenance metadata are preserved without post-processing.

Output: 1672 × 941 pixels, approximately 16:9 with raster rounding. The tool returned this size rather than the requested 2048 × 1152.

## Final prompt

Use case: ui-mockup / premium GitHub README cover.
Primary request: Redesign the existing Codex Usage Badge cover to feel like beautifully crafted native desktop UI, guided by the reference moodboard's translucent controls, soft glass, thin highlights, and disciplined iconography. Deliver ONE complete landscape cover, exactly 2048 x 1152 pixels, 16:9.
Input image 1 is the OLD cover: preserve the product name and the three product ideas, but replace its physical hardware sculpture, thick metallic bevels and freestanding 3D folders with a convincing native software interface.
Input image 2 is a STYLE MOODBOARD only. Borrow restrained material and UI craft, never copy the collage, its text, logos, brands, watermarks, browser or Pinterest controls.

Composition: generous quiet negative space, about 60% of the canvas, wide outer margins. A compact, optically balanced horizontal composition centered vertically. On the left, restrained off-white SF-style sans-serif typography: the exact title on two lines "Codex" and "Usage Badge"; underneath, much smaller cool gray text "Quota / Folders / Tokens". Clean editorial spacing. No other marketing copy.
On the right, one coherent front-facing dark translucent native sidebar component, about 30% of the canvas width and 34% of canvas height. This is a SOFTWARE surface viewed straight on, extremely shallow depth, rounded continuous corners, thin high-quality edge highlights, subtle backdrop blur, soft shadow; no perspective distortion or physical slab. Integrate a narrow vertical quota capsule at its left, with two beautifully centered small green progress rings stacked vertically, showing synthetic values "86%" and "67%" with tiny labels "5h" and "Week". Slim smooth strokes, crisp flat type, no thick inner cavities, no chrome rim. To the right within the same sidebar surface, three properly aligned project rows with small flat outlined folder icons in blue, amber and soft violet, and simple text "Design", "Research", "Notes". Beneath them, three small conversation rows identified by small rounded blue squares of increasing blue brightness and short muted gray text strokes. This conveys Token indicators without numerical clutter. Use authentic compact native spacing, consistent stroke weights and a comfortable hierarchy. The component should feel directly usable, refined and plausible, not like a render of a plastic gadget.

Backdrop: smooth near-black charcoal, slightly lighter than pure black, a very subtle soft bluish-gray ambient illumination only behind the UI. No horizon, floor, pedestal, shiny reflection, texture, noise, abstract decoration or large color blobs.
Materials: dark graphite glass with restrained frosted translucency, a very faint green tint around the quota rings and very faint blue edge light, understated tactile depth as in the best reference controls. Precise pixels and immaculate typography. The image should look like a polished native product launch cover, calm and professional with lots of breathing room.
Constraints: keep every object well inside the frame. No real account data, avatars, screenshots, OpenAI logo, Apple logo, watermarks, fake sponsor logos, excess words, neon bloom, cyberpunk, oversized glass bubbles, toy-like icons, exploded elements, 3D lettering, or repeated panels. Maintain accurate spelling and clean alignment.
